input.quote: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and approaches the walk-away position of an exclusive foreign venue. It also directly contradicts Section 28.2, which already gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction. We replaced only the jurisdiction and forum words with New York law and New York County courts, keeping the sentence structure intact and consistent with 28.2; the 28.3 escalation process is acceptable.

ops.oldText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and Singapore courts with New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in New York County, which is our accepted governing-law position and also removes the conflict with the New York venue already agreed in Section 28.2. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales (courts of London).
proposal.summary: Change governing law and venue from Singapore to New York, aligning 28.1 with 28.2.
